selection.criteria: ActiveCampaign provider-published llms API Reference index was enumerated once; each listed reference fragment was fetched directly and only provider fragments whose server URL names the connector's /api/3 REST scope were combined. No recursive reference traversal was used.

connectors.evidence_source: Provider-published https://developers.activecampaign.com/llms.txt and directly linked /reference/*.md OpenAPI fragments.
connectors.counting_note: The official index contains 147 reference links. The current direct extraction identifies 87 fragments whose declared server URL contains /api/3; each contains exactly one unique documented operation. The resulting immutable v3 inventory has exactly 40 GET/HEAD reads and 47 mutation writes, with no duplicate method/path pair.
connectors.selection_reason: direct official-reference extraction after the generic parser treated the llms index as an invalid OpenAPI document
